contexts.text: (The antediluvians) were all extinguished. AC 563.
Extinguish, suffocate, or pervert good and truth.
The extinction of interior truth. Signified.
To put to death = to extinguish.
The extinction of the essential of doctrine concerning the Lord's Divine Human. Signified.
To smite = to extinguish.
In Hell... the one wants to extinguish the other.
The Intellectual of truth extinguished. Signified.
The life from the love of self... then begins to be extinguished, for it is suffocated...
They extinguish them, and thus induce thick darkness.
The extinction of faith without charity. Signified.
Falsities reject and extinguish all the light which enlightens.
What is scientific of truth shall be extinguished. Signified.
They thus extinguish the truths of faith which are of worship. Signified.
Good and truth... are either rejected, extinguished, or perverted.
With those with whom they are extinguished (good and truth) are denied, and evils and falsities contrary to them are affirmed.
Thus the natural life is extinguished.
Thou shalt not kill = ... not to extinguish faith and charity.
Under Die, see this reference. AC 9035. AC 9126.
To extinguish all the light of truth from the Ward. Signified.
They thus extinguish all mutual love and innocence in little children...
From dead animals.
The extinction of spiritual life with many from the falsified truths of the Word. Signified.
The falsification or extinction of truths. Signified. AE 720.
The extinction of spiritual life. Signified. AE 589.
The extinction of truth and good through falsities and evils. Signified. AE 600:13. AE 652.
The plenary extinction of Divine truth and Divine good. Signified.
